I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I checked #central-team, the other channels you're in and the public files, and none of them mention Brackenwater or a renewal date for it. I only looked at places you can see yourself.

I replied in your thread saying the same, and suggested treating 8 April as hearsay for now. It shouldn't go in a tracker or to the customer until someone checks it against the contract or with whoever owns the account.

I also saved a note in this channel that the date is unverified, so it won't be taken as fact later.
